summary: The model's thinking: a shimmering line while it thinks, then how long it took, which folds open to the steps.

props.name: children
props.description: The steps of the thinking, shown when it is open.

props.name: thinking
props.description: Still thinking: a shimmering line, open on its steps.

props.name: seconds
props.description: How long it thought, for the line once it is done.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Open at the start. It folds itself away when thinking ends.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius of the line's focus. Inherits the nearest `Shape`.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. `merge` folds them in last, so one here replaces the component's own class for the same utility.

props.name: focus
props.description: The focus outline. `true` draws it, `false` removes it, and a string of Yumma CSS utilities restyles it on every focusable part of the component, which is more than `className` reaches. Removing it outright and putting nothing back fails WCAG 2.4.7.

children.text: The ask is about photos from a trip, so the Photos folder is the place to start.
